notes: Garruk, Unleashed, printed: '[-7]: You get an emblem with "At the beginning of your end step, you may search your library for a creature card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle."' It is a 'may': at my end step I decline. Nothing is searched, no creature is put onto the battlefield and, the shuffle being part of what I may do, the library is NOT shuffled: it keeps its order exactly (top first: Library Beast, Library Sorcery, Library Elf, then the six filler cards).
